payout_quote: Share the Green. Refer a friend, and you will both get $100.
steps: Be a current TD Bank personal checking customer
Complete the TD referral form with your details and give it to your friend
Friend brings the referral form in person to a TD Bank store to open a new personal checking account as primary owner
Friend completes the qualifying requirements (per the form/offer terms) and you both receive $100
catches: Cap: up to 10 referral bonuses per calendar year (10 x $100 = $1,000)
Friend must be a brand-new TD Bank personal checking customer with no existing or prior personal TD checking account
Friend must open the account IN PERSON at a TD Bank store presenting the completed referral form — no fully-online referral path
Referrer must be a current TD Bank personal checking customer
Both accounts must be open and in good standing when bonuses are paid
biggest_catch: Your friend must physically visit a TD Bank store with the referral form to open the account — there is no online-only referral flow.
eligibility: Current TD Bank personal checking customers; referred friends must be new-to-TD personal checking customers
timing: Bonuses paid after friend completes qualifying requirements; accounts must remain open and in good standing
